title: Compute minimal polynomials in a zero-dimensional quotient

source.citation: John Abbott and Anna Maria Bigatti, Groebner Bases for Everyone with CoCoA-5 and CoCoALib, arXiv:1611.07306

translation.notes: For the source’s zero-dimensional ideal, eliminating `y,z` produces the principal intersection `I ∩ Q[x] = (x^6-1)`. This is exactly its first quotient minimal-polynomial example.
